evidence.description: BNM apikijangportal Open API returns HTTP 200 with row content_date that is months-to-years old. Three different staleness profiles exist on the same HTTP-200 signature: (1) bnm_base_rate is a genuinely dormant reference series with content_date=2020-08-06; (2) bnm_opr is a declared-monthly series with content_date=2026-05-07 (~4 months stale); (3) bnm_kijang_emas is declared-daily with content_date=2026-08-26 (~6 days stale, possible declared-cadence drift).

impact_on_claim_or_decision: Agent callers using bnm_opr or bnm_kijang_emas without checking row date would treat them as fresh because HTTP 200 suggests availability. Source-card document captures this in known_false_positives.
resolution_or_quarantine: Documented in notes/source-cards/bnm-open-api.md. Consumers MUST inspect content_date directly when status=stale AND data_type_mix.reference is non-zero.
rule_or_policy_change: Probe rule emits content_date and anomaly_detected; source-card verification asserts all three datasets are known false positives.

regression_test.description: Verifier requires the three HTTP-200-but-stale datasets to appear in the BNM source card's known_false_positives.
